A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Struct2D and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices. Corresponding content can be matched reliably, including the broader-impacts appendix renumbered after v3's new failure analysis.

before.justification: V2 reports original GPT-o3 prompting experiments, fine-tuned Qwen benchmark results, ablations and qualitative outputs, including appendix results on grounding and captioning.

after.justification: V3 retains those original experiments and adds Qwen2.5-VL-7B results on VSI-Bench and an analysis of failures among 30 questions.

M1.justification: The perception pipeline, BEV and metadata prompting, keyframe-selection algorithm and fine-tuning procedure remain unchanged. The 7B model newly evaluated on VSI-Bench was already used for other benchmarks in v2.

E1.justification: Both retain the same Struct2D-Set sources and eight task categories, along with VSI-Bench, ScanQA, SQA3D, ScanRefer, Multi3DRefer and Scan2Cap evaluations. The new failure analysis uses questions from existing VSI-Bench coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership remains unchanged in the corresponding benchmark tables, including GPT4Scene, R1-Zero-VSI and the prompting and video-tuning baselines. Table 3's added row is another configuration of the proposed method.

E3.justification: V3 adds the Qwen2.5-VL-7B SFT configuration to the existing VSI-Bench evaluation and introduces a 30-question qualitative error-analysis sample. Existing benchmark metrics, the 422-question zero-shot subset and stated training hyperparameters are retained.

E4.justification: New Appendix E and Figure 13 analyze perception-related failures across 30 VSI-Bench questions, distinguishing reconstruction problems from missed detections. The existing prompting, QA-augmentation and reasoning-token ablations remain unchanged.

E5.justification: There is no change to repeated-run information, seeds, confidence intervals, significance testing or uncertainty reporting. The new failure counts describe inspected cases without introducing an uncertainty-estimation procedure.

E6.justification: Table 3 adds 7B results: average 43.6, relative direction 45.9 and route planning 35.8; the existing 3B results, including average 41.9, are retained. These are additional model-size results, not same-setting improvements. V3 also reports a new 6-to-4-hour training-time comparison and 16 failures among 30 inspected questions, attributed to reconstruction in 11 cases and missed detections in five.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(3) and the geometric constructions for directions, distances and navigation remain unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: spatial reasoning through structured 2D inputs, the 200K-QA Struct2D-Set and effective instruction tuning. The added results support these existing claims without redefining their scope.

C2.justification: Appendix E newly explains how noisy or incomplete reconstruction obscures BEV layouts and missed detections remove spatial cues, particularly for small or occluded objects. This adds specific performance limitations beyond the retained discussion of preprocessing costs and indoor-scene scope.

D1.justification: Section 4.3 changes the reported hardware from four to eight H200 GPUs and clarifies that eight hours refers to training on the whole dataset. This resolves its disagreement with Appendix C, which already specified eight GPUs in v2; it does not establish a rerun. Section 3.1 also newly discloses a 6-to-4-hour training-time comparison, without detailed conditions.

R1.justification: The same 103 references and substantive related-work positioning are retained, including the distinctions from GPT4Scene prompting and methods requiring point-cloud features.

P1.justification: V3 standardizes LMM terminology to MLLM, abbreviates the title and updates affiliation and conference information. It adds a short failure-analysis section and renumbers Broader impacts from Appendix E to F while preserving the main narrative.

P2.justification: V3 adds the two-panel Figure 13, expands Table 3 with the 7B row, adjusts table formatting and updates labels and rendering in Figures 1 and 7. Existing figures and tables are otherwise preserved, with limited layout reflow.

improvement.justification: V3 improves transparency through the concrete failure breakdown in Appendix E and resolves the GPU-count inconsistency between Section 4.3 and Appendix C. The added 7B evaluation provides limited further validation. Its higher scores involve a larger model, and the new timing comparison lacks detailed conditions, so these additions support a modest overall improvement.
